title: Prism Burnisher
pages: Craft from sealed steel, Attuned Quartz, a Tumbled Prism Bead, quartz, hopper and Prism Separator. Tumble the bead first in the Prism Tumbler. Put quartz blocks directly north and south of the drum; missing or unloaded pads halt work.

Feed 24 FE/t or crank. Top and horizontal ports import, bottom exports; configure each face in the menu. Inventory, power, progress and ports persist. JEI lists twenty datapack recipes for surface finishing and optical sheets.

Burnish Attuned Quartz into a Burnished Prism Sheet. The sheet replaces one sealed steel corner of the Prism Lapidary craft, so it gates the next t7 apparatus without a cycle. Stone polishing jobs (andesite, basalt, blackstone, diorite, granite, stone, stone bricks, polished blackstone and quartz blocks) take four blocks for five; sandstone, red sandstone and end stone stay one-to-one because other machines recover them.
